name: flow_join_code_lenient
description: A party code is five symbols from 23456789BCDFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ, shown as K7Q-4M; the Join panel (J) takes it in lower case with spaces or hyphens, says when a symbol cannot be in a code, and joins as the fifth symbol lands.

steps.assert: Session.clean_code('k7q-4m') == 'K7Q4M' and Session.clean_code('K7Q 4M') == 'K7Q4M' and Session.clean_code(' k7q4m ') == 'K7Q4M'
steps.msg: lower case, spaces and hyphens are fine

steps.assert: Session.code_ok('K7Q4M') and not Session.code_ok('K7O4M') and not Session.code_ok('K7Q41') and not Session.code_ok('K7Q4') and not Session.code_ok('K7Q4MM')
steps.msg: five code symbols: no O, no 1, no fewer or more
a code with a symbol no code has joins nothing
J opens the Join panel, the code field ready
Esc closes it, even from the field

steps.assert: node('CodeField').text == 'k7o' and node('CodeHint').text == 'No O in a code: 2-9 and consonants'
steps.msg: typed in lower case; it says which symbol cannot be in a code
spaces and hyphens do not count as symbols
the fifth symbol joins at once
the server was asked to join, by the code
